raw_text: Follow-up OSINT on the Indian Chronicles network. We've mapped the content syndication pipeline: articles originate from 4 core editorial hubs, get rewritten by a pool of approximately 20 writers (some using pen names matching deceased journalists), then distributed to regional satellite sites. The network's output averages 120 articles per day across all outlets. Content themes cluster around: anti-Pakistan narratives (38%), pro-India UN lobbying (27%), Kashmir coverage (22%), and general geopolitical commentary (13%). Several of the fake NGOs created by the network submitted written statements to the UN Human Rights Council between 2017 and 2022. The infrastructure cost of maintaining 750+ domains is estimated at $50,000-80,000 annually.
